ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for this lecture and an online DD section. The following information is provided in an effort to help you better plan your academic (course) schedule for the Fall semester: The course content (lecture material) will be asynchronous, which means that there will be pre-recorded lecture materials and other resources available through Compass 2G that you can consume as your schedule permits. The testing will be synchronous, which means that you will get tested during some of your scheduled Lecture and Discussion Section times. Make absolutely sure that you do Not willingly/knowingly schedule conflicts in your schedule that would overlap with the days/times assigned to our course. For example, the four on-line exams (45-minutes in duration each) and the on-line, multiple-choice Final Exam (45-minutes in duration) will be available only during the days/times that the university has assigned to our course. Since the exams are offered during the regularly scheduled, in-class days/times, there are No Conflict Exams. There are No Make-up Exams – Instead, you get to drop your lowest exam score.
